1.ar: لما نبدأ ننظر: هذا المال، وش المال؟
1.en: When we start to look at it: this wealth — what is it?

3.en: Wealth — and you love wealth with immense love.

5.ar: فكيف تضبطه؟ والمال… شوف المال يعني بعض
5.en: So how do you control it? And wealth — some

6.ar: الناس جاه فلوس، يقول لك: والله فلان تغيّر
6.en: people get money and they say: so-and-so changed

7.ar: بالفلوس. المال لا يغيّر، الفلوس لا تغيّر
7.en: with money. Money doesn't change, money doesn't change

10.en: It exposes; the rich is rich even

11.en: and the generous is generous even if he becomes poor,

12.en: and the mean is mean even if he gains power.

13.ar: بس هي تكشفنا، المال يكشفنا، التعاملات
13.en: It only exposes us — money exposes us; dealings

14.en: with money expose us and strip our masks.
